After reviewing the relevant sections of your file, the **root cause** of your error is an **indentation/parenthesis mismatch** in your Interviewer Dashboard return block.

### The Problem

In this block:
```tsx
if (userRole === 'interviewer') {
  return (
    <>
      {/* Quantum Loading Screen */}
      <QuantumLoading ... />
      {/* Interviewer Dashboard */}
      <div className={isLoading ? "hidden" : "block h-screen"}>
        <InterviewerDashboard ... />
    </div>
    </>
  )
}
```
Notice that the `<div>` containing `<InterviewerDashboard ... />` is **not properly closed** before the fragment closes. The closing `</div>` is at the same level as the fragment, but it should be inside the fragment.

### The Fix

**Indent the closing `</div>` so it matches the opening `<div>`, and ensure all tags are properly nested.**

#### Corrected block:
```tsx
if (userRole === 'interviewer') {
  return (
    <>
      {/* Quantum Loading Screen */}
      <QuantumLoading ... />
      {/* Interviewer Dashboard */}
      <div className={isLoading ? "hidden" : "block h-screen"}>
        <InterviewerDashboard ... />
      </div>
    </>
  )
}
```
**The only change is moving the closing `</div>` to be inside the fragment, not outside.**
